snippet.title: Pawns of War - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Add to your steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509740/Pawns_of_War/

Dark parallel world in which humanity has destroyed itself. And only small colonies have survived the last centuries holding on to power at the expense of the totalitarian regime of government. You were thrown here after your death, is this how you were given a second chance? This is Pawn of War.
